Till We Meet Again

Till we meet again

Till we meet again Dear Jung Wook, I'm not good at writing letters, and I know you don't like anything cringe, so I won’t make this too long... I am sad that you are leaving. You mean a lot to me. You’re one of the sweetest, warmest, and most special people I’ve met, and I know you’re a little cynical, but I hope you know that :). You have been so lovely and encouraging to me when I was going through one of the toughest moments of my life and I will always remember you for that... I really hope that I was able to give you at least a fraction of the encouragement and comfort you gave to me. But beyond that I have genuinely really loved talking to you and spending time with you. I really feel like I can be myself with you. I don’t feel that way with most people, so I really appreciate you for that. You’ve also shown me a completely new perspective on life. And although we argue about some (lol), our conversations have always been so fun and refreshing, and I really liked listening to you try to explain your POV to me ahahah. I know you (and your mum (lol)) think that you will never be happy, but I really hope you know that is not true. I’ve decided to be happy, and I hope you will be too. I think happiness is all around as long as you look for it in those little moments.... I know you don’t believe In God, but I will keep praying for you, and whatever the outcome I am 100% sure you will love where you end up. I know people lose touch with distance, but I really hope we remain friends! I hope you will keep me updated on your life, and I will mine! Till we meet again :) With Love, Gloria
